parameters.help_en: The region ID

parameters.name: group_id

java

shell

http

dataworks
k8s
springschedule
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，目前支持以下几种任务类型：

java
python
shell
go
http

k8s

parameters.help_en: The job name
parameters.help_zh: 任务名
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The job description
parameters.help_zh: 任务描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode of the job. Valid values:

standalone: standalone execution.
broadcast: broadcast execution.
parallel: visualized MapReduce.
batch: MapReduce.
sharding: sharding execution
parameters.help_zh:
任务执行模式，目前支持以下几种任务执行模式：

单机运行：standalone
广播运行：broadcast
可视化MapReduce：parallel
MapReduce：batch
分片运行：sharding
parameters.name: execute_mode

parameters.help_en:
The full path of the job interface class.

This parameter is required and must be set to the full path only when the job type is set to Java
parameters.help_zh:
任务接口类完整路径。

当您选择Java任务类型时，才有该字段且必须填写完整路径
parameters.name: class_name

parameters.help_en:
If the job type is python, shell, or k8s, enter the corresponding script content.
If the job type is golang, the content format example is {"jobName":"HelloWorld"}
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型选择为python/shell/k8s时，填写对应的脚本内容。
任务类型为golang时，content格式示例为 {"jobName":"HelloWorld"}
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The custom parameters. These parameters can be obtained during runtime
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数，运行时可以获取
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of concurrently running instances. Default value: 1. If the previous instance has not finished running when the next scheduled time arrives, the next instance is not triggered
parameters.help_zh: 最大同时运行实例数量，默认值为1，即上次触发没有运行结束，即使到了运行时刻也不会进行下次触发
parameters.name: max_concurrency

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of retries allowed upon failure. Set this parameter based on your business requirements. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 错误最大重试次数，根据业务需求填写，默认值为0
parameters.name: max_attempt

parameters.help_en: The retry interval upon failure. Unit: seconds. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 错误重试间隔，单位s，默认值为30
parameters.name: attempt_interval

parameters.help_en: The advanced configuration for parallel grid jobs. The number of subtasks pulled at a time. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 并行网格任务高级配置，单次拉取子任务数，默认值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The advanced configuration for parallel grid jobs. The number of execution threads triggered on a single node at a time. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 并行网格任务高级配置，单机单次触发执行线程数，默认值为5
parameters.name: consumer_size

parameters.help_en: The advanced configuration for parallel grid jobs. The maximum cache size of the subtask queue. Default value: 10000
parameters.help_zh: 并行网格任务高级配置，子任务队列缓存上限，默认值为10000
parameters.name: queue_size

parameters.help_en: The advanced configuration for parallel grid jobs. The number of threads used to dispatch subtasks. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 并行网格任务高级配置，子任务分发线程数，默认值为5
parameters.name: dispatcher_size

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling time type. This parameter specifies the scheduling type, not a specific date, time, or timestamp. Valid values:

1: cron.
3: fixed_rate.
4: second_delay.
5: one_time.
100: api.
-1: none
parameters.help_zh: 调度时间类型枚举；该字段表示调度类型，不表示具体日期、时间或时间戳。取值：1 表示 cron，3 表示 fixed_rate，4 表示 second_delay，5 表示 one_time，100 表示 api，-1 表示 none
parameters.name: time_type

parameters.help_en:
The time expression. Set this parameter based on the selected time type.

cron: Enter a standard cron expression. Online verification is supported.
api: No time expression is required.
fixed_rate: Enter a specific fixed frequency value in seconds. For example, 30 indicates that the job is triggered every 30 seconds.
second_delay: Enter a fixed delay in seconds (1 to 60 seconds).
one_time: Enter a specific time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format or a timestamp in milliseconds, such as "2022-10-10 10:10:00"
parameters.help_zh:
时间表达式，根据选择的时间类型设置时间表达式。

cron：填写标准的cron表达式，支持在线验证。
api：无时间表达式。
fixed_rate：填写具体固定频率值，单位s。如30表示每隔30s触发一次。
second_delay：填写固定延迟多少秒执行一次（1s~60s可选）。
one_time: 填写指定时间（yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss）或者时间戳（毫秒），比如"2022-10-10 10:10:00"
parameters.name: time_expression

parameters.help_en: The custom calendar. This parameter is available when the time type is set to cron
parameters.help_zh: cron类型可以选择填写自定义日历
parameters.name: calendar

parameters.help_en: The time offset. Unit: seconds. This parameter is available when the time type is set to cron
parameters.help_zh: cron类型可以选择时间偏移，单位s
parameters.name: data_offset

parameters.help_en: The time zone
parameters.help_zh: 时区
parameters.name: timezone

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the timeout alert feature. Valid values:

true: enables the timeout alert feature.
false: disables the timeout alert feature
parameters.help_zh:
超时报警开关。取值如下：

true：开启超时报警开关。
false：关闭超时报警开关
parameters.name: timeout_enable

parameters.help_en: The timeout threshold. Unit: seconds. Default value: 7200
parameters.help_zh: 超时阈值，单位s，默认值7200
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the timeout termination feature. Valid values:

true: enables the timeout termination feature.
false: disables the timeout termination feature
parameters.help_zh:
超时终止开关。取值如下：

true：开启超时终止开关。
false：关闭超时终止开关
parameters.name: timeout_kill_enable

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the failure alert feature. Valid values:

true: enables the failure alert feature.
false: disables the failure alert feature
parameters.help_zh:
失败报警开关。取值如下：

true：开启失败报警开关。
false：关闭失败报警开关
parameters.name: fail_enable

parameters.help_en: The number of consecutive failures that trigger an alert
parameters.help_zh: 连续失败报警次数
parameters.name: fail_times

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the alert for no available workers. Valid values:

true: enables the alert for no available workers.
false: disables the alert for no available workers
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启无可用机器报警。
true：开启无可用机器报警开关。
false：关闭无可用机器报警开关
parameters.name: miss_worker_enable

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the success notification feature
parameters.help_zh: 成功通知开关
parameters.name: success_notice_enable

The alert notification channel. Valid values:

default: the default channel for the application group.
sms, mail, phone, webhook: specified channels for the job

告警通知渠道。

按应用分组默认渠道：default。
指定任务发送渠道：sms,mail,phone,webhook

The job priority. Valid values:

1: low.

10: high.

任务优先级。取值如下：
1：低

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp. Unit: milliseconds. The value must be later than the current time. A value of -1 indicates that the job starts immediately
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间戳，单位为毫秒；该值需晚于当前时间，-1 表示立即开始
